data.name: The Beyond
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to The Beyond!

Your next favorite co-op shooter in space with two modes!

This PVE Shooter will feature a Survival Mode, and a Raid Mode!

Survival: 

  • 1-6 Players

  • Same base character, but you can customize it!!

  • Objective: Defend the base at all cost from ongoing waves of enemies, utilizing the Shop, where you can buy guns, ammo, armor, and upgrades, and the Mod Box, where you can upgrade your guns.

Raid: 

  • 4-10 Players 

  • Objective: Work with your squad to overcome multiple environments you encounter, explore these environments to find rare items, and also put those squad skills to use to take down big bosses for big rewards!

  • 10 Roles to choose from!

  • Teamwork will be very crucial in this mode!!

Third person is the main play style, however, you will have multiple camera angles to choose from.

-The Beyond is being developed by a two-man team, with designs to grow in the future, and the current goal in mind is to have a playable demo by the end of 2026!

data.short_description: A sci-fi co-op shooter in space with two modes! Whether you want to see how long you and your teammates can last while protecting your base or you all want to go hunt down bosses together and collect cool stuff, The Beyond has a little of everything! Character customization, gun upgrades, and more!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i3-3225 3.3 GHz or AMD Ryzen 3 3300U
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 265KF (3.90 GHz)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
